text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard all for this day, but I
just wasn't
good enough...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's kind of you to say, Trainer...
choice_data_list: 今日までの頑張りを次に繋げよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's carry all the hard work we've done so far into the next one!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost, but I gave it my all out
on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What I need is the skill to claim first
place. I'm
going to work even harder
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's enough feeling sorry for myself!
It's time to
set my sights on my next
race!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And for that, I need to train even harder!
